_note: Every farmer-facing string, Marathi. Marathi first because it is written in Devanagari: the Noto Sans Devanagari the app already ships renders it unchanged, where Punjabi, Bengali, Telugu and Tamil each need another font in the APK.
_register: ALWAYS the तुम्ही form, never तू. Same rule as the Hindi file: the app is talking to an adult stranger.
_vocabulary: The word a Maharashtra farmer says, not the word a dictionary gives. शेत not खेत, जनावर not पशु, लस not टीका, फवारणी not छिड़काव, करपा not झुलसा, लाळ्या खुरकूत for FMD. No developer words: no स्लाइड, no नेटवर्क (say इंटरनेट), no मोड.
_validation_warning: NOT reviewed by a Marathi speaker. Agricultural and veterinary terms carry real risk: a wrong disease name sends a farmer to the wrong spray. Get a Maharashtra KVK officer or a Marathi-speaking agronomist to read this file before it goes in front of anyone. The app offers Marathi only because content/validate.py confirms all 238 keys exist, which proves the file is complete, not that it is right.
_deliberate_gap: The UI is Marathi. Vaccine names in vaccination_schedule.json are Marathi. symptom_tree.json (73 strings of vet logic) and treatment_plans.json (119 strings of chemical names and doses) are NOT, and fall back to Hindi through L(). That is on purpose and it is the safer half of the trade: a wrong disease NAME confuses a farmer, a wrong DOSE poisons a crop or an animal, and nobody here reads Marathi well enough to be trusted with a dose. Translate those two files only with the KVK officer in the room, not before.

help.body: फोटोचं नारंगी बटण दाबून पानाचा फोटो घ्या. जनावर आजारी वाटलं तर जनावरांच्या भागात जाऊन प्रश्नांची उत्तरं द्या. काहीही विचारायचं असेल तर खालच्या हिरव्या बटणावर बोलून किंवा लिहून विचारा. शेत आणि जनावरं, दोन्हींचा पूर्ण हिशेब नोंदवहीत मिळेल.
help.offline: इंटरनेट नसलं तरी फोटोवरून रोग ओळखणं, जनावराची तपासणी आणि नोंदवही, हे तिन्ही चालतात.

about.model: रोग ओळखणारा भाग फोनच्या आत चालतो, इंटरनेटशिवायही.
